package generatedcourse

import (
	"context"
	"crypto/sha256"
	"encoding/hex"
	"encoding/json"
	"errors"
	"strconv"
	"strings"
	"time"

	"github.com/example/mc-course-service/internal/domain"
	"github.com/example/mc-course-service/internal/domain/repository"
	"github.com/google/uuid"
)

type IDGenerator interface {
	NewID() string
}

type Clock interface {
	Now() time.Time
}

type revisionResolver interface {
	FreezeGeneratedReceipt(context.Context, string, []domain.GeneratedLessonBinding) ([]domain.GeneratedLessonBinding, error)
}

type Ensure struct {
	Revisions      revisionResolver
	Generated      repository.GeneratedCourseRepository
	Courses        repository.CourseRepository
	CourseI18n     repository.CourseI18nRepository
	Modules        repository.ModuleRepository
	ModuleI18n     repository.ModuleI18nRepository
	CourseModules  repository.CourseModuleRepository
	Sections       repository.SectionRepository
	SectionI18n    repository.SectionI18nRepository
	ModuleSections repository.ModuleSectionRepository
	Lessons        repository.LessonRepository
	LessonI18n     repository.LessonI18nRepository
	SectionLessons repository.SectionLessonRepository
	Examples       repository.LessonExampleRepository
	Tasks          repository.TaskRepository
	TaskI18n       repository.TaskI18nRepository
	TaskTargets    repository.TaskLearningTargetRepository
	StructureTypes repository.CodeStructureTypeRepository
	I18n           repository.I18nRepository
	Tx             repository.TransactionManager
	Publisher      domain.EventPublisher
	IDs            IDGenerator
	Clock          Clock
}

func (useCase Ensure) Handle(
	ctx context.Context,
	idempotencyKey string,
	input domain.GeneratedCourse,
) (domain.EnsureGeneratedCourseResult, error) {
	idempotencyKey = strings.TrimSpace(idempotencyKey)
	if _, err := uuid.Parse(idempotencyKey); err != nil || !useCase.configured() {
		return domain.EnsureGeneratedCourseResult{}, domain.ErrValidation
	}
	normalized, err := domain.NormalizeGeneratedCourse(input)
	if err != nil {
		return domain.EnsureGeneratedCourseResult{}, err
	}
	planJSON, err := json.Marshal(normalized)
	if err != nil {
		return domain.EnsureGeneratedCourseResult{}, err
	}
	if len(planJSON) > domain.MaximumGeneratedCoursePayloadBytes {
		return domain.EnsureGeneratedCourseResult{}, domain.ErrValidation
	}
	digest := sha256.Sum256(planJSON)
	requestHash := hex.EncodeToString(digest[:])
	result := domain.EnsureGeneratedCourseResult{}
	createdCourse := false
	err = useCase.Tx.WithTx(ctx, func(ctx context.Context) error {
		if err := useCase.Generated.Lock(ctx, "generated-course-request", idempotencyKey); err != nil {
			return err
		}
		existingRequest, err := useCase.Generated.GetRequest(ctx, idempotencyKey)
		switch {
		case err == nil:
			if existingRequest.RequestHash != requestHash {
				return domain.ErrConflict
			}
			result = domain.EnsureGeneratedCourseResult{
				CourseID: existingRequest.CourseID, Reused: existingRequest.Reused,
			}
			return nil
		case !errors.Is(err, domain.ErrNotFound):
			return err
		}
		fingerprintKey := normalized.FingerprintVersion + ":" + normalized.Fingerprint
		if err := useCase.Generated.Lock(ctx, "generated-course-fingerprint", fingerprintKey); err != nil {
			return err
		}
		courseID, err := useCase.Generated.GetCourseIDByFingerprint(
			ctx, domain.GeneratedCourseOriginLearningPlanner, normalized.FingerprintVersion, normalized.Fingerprint,
		)
		switch {
		case err == nil:
			result = domain.EnsureGeneratedCourseResult{CourseID: courseID, Reused: true}
			return useCase.Generated.CreateRequest(ctx, domain.GeneratedCourseRequest{
				IdempotencyKey: idempotencyKey, RequestHash: requestHash, CourseID: courseID, Reused: true,
			})
		case !errors.Is(err, domain.ErrNotFound):
			return err
		}
		courseID, err = useCase.nextID()
		if err != nil {
			return err
		}
		if err := useCase.createCourse(ctx, courseID, normalized, planJSON); err != nil {
			return err
		}
		if err := useCase.Generated.CreateRequest(ctx, domain.GeneratedCourseRequest{
			IdempotencyKey: idempotencyKey, RequestHash: requestHash, CourseID: courseID, Reused: false,
		}); err != nil {
			return err
		}
		result = domain.EnsureGeneratedCourseResult{CourseID: courseID, Reused: false}
		createdCourse = true
		return nil
	})
	if err != nil {
		return domain.EnsureGeneratedCourseResult{}, err
	}
	result.Lessons, err = useCase.Generated.ListLessonBindings(ctx, result.CourseID)
	if err != nil || len(result.Lessons) == 0 {
		if err == nil {
			err = domain.ErrValidation
		}
		return domain.EnsureGeneratedCourseResult{}, err
	}
	if useCase.Revisions != nil {
		result.Lessons, err = useCase.Revisions.FreezeGeneratedReceipt(ctx, idempotencyKey, result.Lessons)
		if err != nil {
			return domain.EnsureGeneratedCourseResult{}, err
		}
	}
	if createdCourse && useCase.Publisher != nil {
		_ = useCase.Publisher.Publish(ctx, domain.SubjectCourseCreated, map[string]any{
			"course_id": result.CourseID, "slug": "planned-" + normalized.Fingerprint,
		})
	}
	return result, nil
}

func (useCase Ensure) configured() bool {
	return useCase.Generated != nil && useCase.Courses != nil && useCase.CourseI18n != nil &&
		useCase.Modules != nil && useCase.ModuleI18n != nil && useCase.CourseModules != nil &&
		useCase.Sections != nil && useCase.SectionI18n != nil && useCase.ModuleSections != nil &&
		useCase.Lessons != nil && useCase.LessonI18n != nil && useCase.SectionLessons != nil &&
		useCase.Examples != nil && useCase.Tasks != nil && useCase.TaskI18n != nil && useCase.TaskTargets != nil &&
		useCase.StructureTypes != nil && useCase.I18n != nil && useCase.Tx != nil && useCase.IDs != nil && useCase.Clock != nil
}

func (useCase Ensure) createCourse(
	ctx context.Context,
	courseID string,
	input domain.GeneratedCourse,
	planJSON []byte,
) error {
	language, err := useCase.I18n.GetByLanguage(ctx, input.Language)
	if errors.Is(err, domain.ErrNotFound) {
		if err := useCase.I18n.Create(ctx, domain.I18n{Language: input.Language}); err != nil {
			return err
		}
		language, err = useCase.I18n.GetByLanguage(ctx, input.Language)
	}
	if err != nil {
		return err
	}
	now := useCase.Clock.Now().UTC()
	course := domain.Course{
		ID: courseID, Slug: "planned-" + input.Fingerprint,
		SourceKey: generatedSourceKey("course", input.Fingerprint, input.GoalCode, input.GoalVersion),
		CreatedAt: now, UpdatedAt: now, Status: domain.CourseStatusActive, CatalogVisible: false,
	}
	if err := useCase.Courses.Create(ctx, course); err != nil {
		return err
	}
	if err := useCase.CourseI18n.Upsert(ctx, domain.CourseI18n{
		CourseID: courseID, I18nID: language.ID, Title: input.Title, Description: input.Description,
	}); err != nil {
		return err
	}
	if err := useCase.Generated.CreateCourseRecord(ctx, domain.GeneratedCourseRecord{
		CourseID: courseID, Origin: domain.GeneratedCourseOriginLearningPlanner,
		Fingerprint: input.Fingerprint, FingerprintVersion: input.FingerprintVersion,
		GoalCode: input.GoalCode, GoalVersion: input.GoalVersion, Language: input.Language,
		PlannerVersion: input.PlannerVersion, PedagogyProfile: input.PedagogyProfile,
		PresentationStyle: input.PresentationStyle, GenerationPolicy: input.GenerationPolicy,
		PlanJSON: planJSON,
	}); err != nil {
		return err
	}
	for _, plannedModule := range input.Modules {
		moduleID, err := useCase.nextID()
		if err != nil {
			return err
		}
		module := domain.Module{
			ID: moduleID, SourceKey: generatedSourceKey("module", input.Fingerprint, plannedModule.Code),
			Status: domain.ModuleStatusActive, Visibility: domain.ModuleVisibilityCourseOnly,
			CreatedAt: now, UpdatedAt: now,
		}
		if err := useCase.Modules.Create(ctx, module); err != nil {
			return err
		}
		if err := useCase.ModuleI18n.Upsert(ctx, domain.ModuleI18n{
			ModuleID: moduleID, I18nID: language.ID, Language: input.Language, Title: plannedModule.Title,
		}); err != nil {
			return err
		}
		if err := useCase.CourseModules.Add(ctx, courseID, moduleID, plannedModule.Order); err != nil {
			return err
		}
		for _, plannedSection := range plannedModule.Sections {
			sectionID, err := useCase.nextID()
			if err != nil {
				return err
			}
			section := domain.Section{
				ID:        sectionID,
				SourceKey: generatedSourceKey("section", input.Fingerprint, plannedModule.Code, plannedSection.Code),
				Status:    domain.SectionStatusActive, CreatedAt: now, UpdatedAt: now,
			}
			if err := useCase.Sections.Create(ctx, section); err != nil {
				return err
			}
			if err := useCase.SectionI18n.Upsert(ctx, domain.SectionI18n{
				SectionID: sectionID, I18nID: language.ID, Language: input.Language, Title: plannedSection.Title,
			}); err != nil {
				return err
			}
			if err := useCase.ModuleSections.Add(ctx, moduleID, sectionID, plannedSection.Order); err != nil {
				return err
			}
			for _, plannedLesson := range plannedSection.Lessons {
				lessonID, err := useCase.nextID()
				if err != nil {
					return err
				}
				lesson := domain.Lesson{
					ID: lessonID,
					SourceKey: generatedSourceKey(
						"lesson", input.Fingerprint, plannedModule.Code, plannedSection.Code, plannedLesson.Code,
					),
					Title: plannedLesson.Title, Excerpt: plannedLesson.Excerpt,
					Description: plannedLesson.DescriptionMarkdown,
					Status:      domain.LessonStatusActive, CreatedAt: now, UpdatedAt: now,
				}
				if err := useCase.Lessons.Create(ctx, lesson); err != nil {
					return err
				}
				if err := useCase.LessonI18n.Upsert(ctx, domain.LessonI18n{
					LessonID: lessonID, I18nID: language.ID, Language: input.Language,
					Title: plannedLesson.Title, Excerpt: plannedLesson.Excerpt,
					Description: plannedLesson.DescriptionMarkdown,
				}); err != nil {
					return err
				}
				if err := useCase.SectionLessons.Add(ctx, sectionID, lessonID, plannedLesson.Order); err != nil {
					return err
				}
				targetsJSON, err := marshalArray(plannedLesson.Targets)
				if err != nil {
					return err
				}
				prerequisitesJSON, err := marshalArray(plannedLesson.Prerequisites)
				if err != nil {
					return err
				}
				transitionsJSON, err := marshalArray(plannedLesson.TransitionKnowledge)
				if err != nil {
					return err
				}
				strategiesJSON, err := marshalArray(plannedLesson.PedagogyStrategies)
				if err != nil {
					return err
				}
				if err := useCase.Generated.CreateLessonRecord(ctx, domain.GeneratedLessonRecord{
					LessonID: lessonID, CourseID: courseID, ModuleCode: plannedModule.Code,
					SectionCode: plannedSection.Code, LessonCode: plannedLesson.Code,
					TargetsJSON: targetsJSON, PrerequisitesJSON: prerequisitesJSON,
					TransitionKnowledgeJSON: transitionsJSON, PedagogyStrategiesJSON: strategiesJSON,
				}); err != nil {
					return err
				}
				if err := useCase.createLessonArtifacts(ctx, language.ID, input, plannedModule, plannedSection, plannedLesson, lessonID, now); err != nil {
					return err
				}
			}
		}
	}
	return nil
}

func (useCase Ensure) createLessonArtifacts(
	ctx context.Context,
	languageID int,
	course domain.GeneratedCourse,
	module domain.GeneratedCourseModule,
	section domain.GeneratedCourseSection,
	lesson domain.GeneratedCourseLesson,
	lessonID string,
	now time.Time,
) error {
	examples := make([]domain.LessonExample, 0, len(lesson.Examples))
	for index, planned := range lesson.Examples {
		exampleID, err := useCase.nextID()
		if err != nil {
			return err
		}
		var primary *string
		if planned.PrimaryStack != "" {
			value := planned.PrimaryStack
			primary = &value
		}
		examples = append(examples, domain.LessonExample{
			ID:        exampleID,
			SourceKey: generatedSourceKey("example", course.Fingerprint, module.Code, section.Code, lesson.Code, strconv.Itoa(index)),
			LessonID:  lessonID, Order: index + 1, Status: domain.LessonExampleStatusActive,
			Mode: "explanation", PrimaryStack: primary, Stacks: planned.Stacks,
			TargetConcepts: planned.TargetConcepts,
			Translations: []domain.LessonExampleI18n{{
				ExampleID: exampleID, I18nID: languageID, Language: course.Language,
				Title: planned.Title, Description: planned.DescriptionMarkdown,
			}}, CreatedAt: now, UpdatedAt: now,
		})
	}
	if err := useCase.Examples.ReplaceByLesson(ctx, lessonID, examples); err != nil {
		return err
	}
	structure, err := useCase.StructureTypes.GetByCode(ctx, "QUIZ_TEXT_BASIC")
	if err != nil {
		return err
	}
	if structure == nil || structure.Code != "QUIZ_TEXT_BASIC" {
		return domain.ErrValidation
	}
	if _, err := uuid.Parse(structure.ID); err != nil {
		return domain.ErrValidation
	}
	for index, planned := range lesson.Tasks {
		taskID, err := useCase.nextID()
		if err != nil {
			return err
		}
		structureJSON, err := json.Marshal(map[string]any{
			"type": "quiz_theory",
			"quiz": map[string]any{"expected_answers": planned.ExpectedAnswers, "ignore_case": true, "trim_space": true},
		})
		if err != nil || domain.ValidateTaskContract(domain.TaskTypeQuizTheory, structureJSON) != nil {
			return domain.ErrValidation
		}
		task := domain.Task{
			ID:        taskID,
			SourceKey: generatedSourceKey("task", course.Fingerprint, module.Code, section.Code, lesson.Code, strconv.Itoa(index)),
			LessonID:  lessonID, Title: planned.Title, Description: planned.DescriptionMarkdown,
			CodeStructureTypeID: structure.ID, CodeStructure: structureJSON,
			Type: domain.TaskTypeQuizTheory, ExecutionMode: domain.TaskExecutionModeNoRun,
			EvaluationMode: domain.TaskEvaluationModeAuto, UIMode: domain.TaskUIModeQuiz,
			SubmissionMode: domain.TaskSubmissionModeAnswerPayload, RequiresSandbox: false,
			Order: index + 1, Status: domain.TaskStatusActive, Version: 1,
			CreatedAt: now, UpdatedAt: now,
		}
		if err := useCase.Tasks.Create(ctx, task); err != nil {
			return err
		}
		if err := useCase.TaskI18n.Upsert(ctx, domain.TaskI18n{
			TaskID: taskID, I18nID: languageID, Language: course.Language,
			Title: planned.Title, Description: planned.DescriptionMarkdown,
		}); err != nil {
			return err
		}
		targets := make([]domain.TaskLearningTarget, len(lesson.Targets))
		for targetIndex, target := range lesson.Targets {
			targets[targetIndex] = domain.TaskLearningTarget{
				TaskID: taskID, Type: target.Type, Key: target.Key, Version: target.Version, Order: targetIndex,
			}
		}
		if err := useCase.TaskTargets.ReplaceForTask(ctx, taskID, targets); err != nil {
			return err
		}
	}
	return nil
}

func (useCase Ensure) nextID() (string, error) {
	value := useCase.IDs.NewID()
	if _, err := uuid.Parse(value); err != nil {
		return "", domain.ErrValidation
	}
	return value, nil
}

func generatedSourceKey(kind string, parts ...string) string {
	digest := sha256.Sum256([]byte(strings.Join(parts, "\x00")))
	return "learning-planner/" + kind + "/" + hex.EncodeToString(digest[:])
}

func marshalArray[T any](items []T) ([]byte, error) {
	if items == nil {
		items = make([]T, 0)
	}
	return json.Marshal(items)
}
